content:
The final EuroProofNet symposium will happen in Orsay (near Paris) from September 8th to September 19th 2025. It gathers six events:

  • LFPSI: 1st International School on Logical Frameworks and Proof Systems Interoperability
  • WG2: Workshop on Automated Reasoning and Proof Logging
  • WG4: Workshop on Proof Libraries
  • MCLP: Conference on Mathematical and Computational Linguistics for Proofs
  • WG3: Workshop on Program Verification
  • MC: Report on EuroProofNet results

May 25 is the deadline for funding requests.

For several of those events, you can propose talks. In particular the workshop on proof libraries is open to contributed talks. And participants from the Lean community had very good experiences with previous workshop on this topic in the same series.

Reminder: the deadline mentioned in the previous message in this thread is May 25th. It would be really great to have talks from members of the Lean community in the workshop on proof libraries. Don’t hesitate to submit a talk proposal. There is no need to write a paper here, it’s only a talk.

Hi. The preliminary program of the EuroProofNet workshop on proof libraries is now online on https://europroofnet.github.io/WG4_Orsay25/. It is great!

Monday 15 September

  • 09:00-09:45 Manuel Eberl (U. Innsbruck, Austria), the Isabelle Archive of Formal Proofs
  • 09:45-10:30 Michael Rothgang (U. Bonn, Germany), growing Lean mathlib: review and triage tooling for a large formalised mathematics library
  • 11:00-11:45 Nicolas Magaud (U. Strasbourg, France), Optimization of Rocq proof scripts
  • Cyril Cohen (Inria Lyon, France), Hierarchy Builder
  • 14:00-14:45 Mohammad Abdulaziz (King’s College London, UK), an Isabelle Library of Combinatorial Optimisation Results
  • 14:45-15:30 Yannick Forster (Inria Paris, France), the Coq Library of undecidability proofs
  • 16:00-16:45 Julien Narboux (U. Paris Cité, France) and Pierre Boutry (U. Strasbourg, France), GeoCoq: a library for foundations of geometry
  • 16:45-17:30 Christian Merten (U. Utrech, Netherlands), algebraic geometry in Lean’s mathematical library mathlib

Tuesday 16 September

  • 09:00-09:45 Sylvie Boldo (Inria Saclay, France), Numerical Analysis in Rocq – Simplicial Lagrange Finite Elements
  • 09:45-10:30 Joseph Tooby-Smith (U. Reykjavik, Iceland), PhysLean: Digitalizing Physics in Lean
  • 11:00-11:45 Kathrin Stark (U. Heriot-Watt, UK), On Autosubst: Mechanising binders in Coq
  • Matthieu Sozeau (Inria Nantes, France), MetaRocq: Metaprogramming and Mechanization of Rocq in Rocq
  • 14:00-14:45 Markus Himmel (Lean FRO, Germany), the Lean standard library: development methodology and tooling
  • Patrick Massot (U. Paris-Saclay, France), coordinating large formalization projects
  • 16:00-16:45 Niels van der Weide (U. Radboud, Netherlands), the Unimath Coq library

We still have one slot free. We would be very happy to have a talk on tools for searching theorems. If you would like to give such a talk, contact me. We may be able to fund your travel to attend the workshop too.
Reminder: the EuroProofNet workshop on proof libraries happens this Monday and Tuesday. The current schedule can be found at https://europroofnet.github.io/WG4_Orsay25/.
